Network Security

Punto di decisione della politica

A logical component in access control architectures (e.g., ABAC, RBAC) that evaluates access requests against policy rules and renders authorization decisions, per NIST SP 800-207 and XACML.

What is Punto di decisione della politica?

In this glossary, Punto di decisione della politica refers to: A logical component in access control architectures (e.g., ABAC, RBAC) that evaluates access requests against policy rules and renders authorization decisions, per NIST SP 800-207 and XACML.

How is Punto di decisione della politica used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Il punto di decisione della politica ha valutato la richiesta di accesso dell’utente secondo le regole definite e ha restituito una risposta di diniego per autenticazione fallita."

Definition

A logical component in access control architectures (e.g., ABAC, RBAC) that evaluates access requests against policy rules and renders authorization decisions, per NIST SP 800-207 and XACML.

Operational example

The policy decision point evaluated the user's access request against defined rules and returned a deny response based on failed authentication.
